simple.meaning: חֹרֹנַיִם (Chôrônayim) is a Hebrew word meaning “Choronajim , a place in Moab.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חֹרֹנַיִם (H2773) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 15:5, with occurrences in Isaiah, Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֹרֹנַיִם (H2773) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חֹרֹנַיִם (H2773) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: חֹרֹנַיִם (Chôrônayim) / H2773 is traced through Isaiah 15:5, Jeremiah 48:3, Jeremiah 48:5, Jeremiah 48:34 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H2773. Choronayim חֹרֹנַיִם חֹרוֺנַיִם, proper name, of a location (possibly two hollows, caves, ravines , see חוֺרֹן בֵּית ) — חרונים דֶּרֶךְ Isa 15:5 ; Jer 48:3 , חֹרוֺנָ֑יִם מוֺרַד 48:5 , חֹרֹנַיִם 48:34 , city of Moab; = MI 31, 32 חורנן (i.e. probably חוֺרֹנֵן ); ᵐ5 Αρωνιειμ , Ωρωνσιμ . — On ᵐ5 חֹרֹנַיִם Josh 13:10-11 , 2Sam 13:34 see We Dr and חוֺרֹן בֵּית .
